title: iDrive setup and controller changes
summary: Feedback centers on the new iDrive setup, with praise for straightforward operation in some comments but more criticism and many unclear remarks about removed controller hardware, menu usability, and settings behavior.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the iDrive setup as straightforward and intuitive, with one favorable comparison to the previous layout.

negative.summary: Negative reviews criticize iDrive 9, unintuitive menus, the loss of the controller or wheel, and increased reliance on the touchscreen as distracting and a step backward.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention getting used to the system, missing the controller, settings being wiped, and other iDrive-related complaints, but the sampled fragments are often too incomplete to classify confidently.

limitations: Many sampled fragments are short or incomplete, which limits confident interpretation of the underlying sentiment.
The undetermined examples include both adaptation comments and complaint-like wording, so the topic contains ambiguity that cannot be cleanly resolved from the provided snippets alone.

The sampled comments focus on several related subtopics—menu design, loss of the rotary controller, touchscreen dependence, and settings retention—so the cluster is not a single narrowly defined issue.
